purpose: Play sprite-sheet (atlas) effects in 3D with per-frame timing and the procedural smoke shader shared by gameplay effects.
state_owner: Atlas layouts (grid, frame count, frame timing) of supplied effect sprite sheets

sprite_flipbook_v1.spawn: spawn(parent: Node, atlas: Dictionary, position: Vector3, size: float, options := {}) -> MeshInstance3D; null when the atlas texture is missing. The node frees itself after the last frame.
sprite_flipbook_v1.frame_at: frame_at(atlas: Dictionary, seconds: float) -> float; fractional frame for a play time, -1 after the end

effect_atlases_v1.atlas: Dictionary {path, columns, rows, frames, durations: Array[float]} per supplied sheet

surface_atlases_v1.material: material(texture: Texture2D, cell: int) -> ShaderMaterial; immutable BULLET/GLASS textures, row-major 4x2, bullet 0..4, scorch 5..7, glass 0..7; per-mark material

runtime_contracts.surface_stamp_v1: build(receiver: MeshInstance3D, projector: Transform3D, size: Vector2, depth: float, skip_glass = false) -> ArrayMesh; immutable receiver, clipped real triangles, continuous projector UV, null if no receiving faces
